Ivy: Quick RFC follow-up  proposing a tiny "compat-gateway" shim at the edge to accept older API payloads and emit the new runtime contract. Opt-in per-tenant. Main goals: avoid runtime churn, keep p99 impact minimal, and preserve cache compatibility.
Ben: High-level +1. Two immediate choices: implement as Envoy Lua/WASM at the gateway, or as a runtime plugin. Gateway = faster iteration but ops/ownership burden; runtime = single ownership but increases code surface.
Sofia: Also streaming semantics matter: older clients send newline-delimited text frames; new runtime expects structured "delta" messages. If we reframe at the gateway we can avoid runtime branching, but will add CPU in the hot path.
Ivy: My suggested incremental approach: 1) header-gated opt-in (X-Compat: v1->v2), 2) best-effort harmonize only stateless renames and schema-safe aliases, 3) emit X-Compat-Applied when successful, 4) fall back to forwarding original with X-Compat-Warn if ambiguous.
Ben: Agree on header gating. Also add a strict mode per-tenant so they can opt to fail on ambiguous transforms (returns 422). Helps partners who want correctness over convenience.
Sofia: Prototype notes from my PoC: envoy-wasm filter did median +1.1ms, p99 +5-7ms for 4KB streaming chunks. Lua was slightly slower under concurrency. WASM seems promising for perf + safety.
platform-bot: Added alert "compat_gateway_error_rate" -> page if >1% for 10m across >=4 tenants. Dashboard panel "Compat Gateway - invocations/latency" created.
Ivy: Telemetry we need: compat_gateway_invoked, compat_gateway_duration_ms, compat_gateway_stream_reframed, compat_gateway_ambiguous_count. Tag by tenant_id, route, and compat_mode. Include request_id for traces.
Ben: Cache key compatibility is the sticky bit. If shim renames fields used in prefix cache or embeddings keys, cache hit rate will drop. Proposal: compute canonical_cache_key(raw_input, stable_schema_vhash) in shim and expose X-Canonical-Cache-Key header so downstream cache layers can use it. Monitor cache_miss_delta metric.
Sofia: For function/tool arg renames, we should map harmless alias names and add X-Tool-Alias-Applied header. But don't change semantics (no implicit conversions). If mapping ambiguous, tombstone the original to S3 and include X-Tombstone-Pointer so debugging is possible.
Ivy: Security: transformations must be declarative maps only. No templating, no exec/eval. All mappings require a signed review by security. security-bot, can you run audit hooks on the mapping bundle?
security-bot: Will run config audit on mapping rules and require redaction-first logging. Any mapping that touches PII must be blocked or reviewed manually. RBAC: only platform-admin and tenant-ops can flip opt-in flags.
Ben: Rollout idea: internal dev tenants (5) -> partner beta (20) -> 100 tenants -> broad. Canary gates: compat_gateway_error_rate, p99_request_latency_delta, canonical_cache_miss_delta. Rollback: flip tenant flag off or remove filter from gateway route.
Sofia: Pseudocode from PoC:
```
if header 'X-Compat' == 'v1->v2':
  if payload.is_stream():
    header_frame = read_frame()
    if can_map_header(header_frame): emit(mapped_header_frame) else if strict: return 422 else: emit(original with X-Compat-Warn
    for chunk in stream: emit(map_chunk(chunk) or original_chunk)
  else:
    mapped = try_map(json_body)
    if mapped.ok: set header X-Compat-Applied: true and forward(mapped)
    else if strict: return 422 else: set header X-Compat-Warn and forward(original)
```
Ivy: Add opt-out TTL: a tenant flag that auto-reverts after N days unless explicitly renewed. Also add a telemetry label "shim_migration_age_days" for cohort tracking.
Ben: Operational notes: gateway team will need a small deployment matrix and perf tests. If usage grows above ~25% traffic we should consider upstreaming frequent mappings into the runtime and deprecating the gateway shim.
Sofia: I'll publish the WASM PoC + perf numbers (ETA 72h). Ivy: can you own the rollout playbook and canonical key spec (ETA 48h)? Ben: I'll coordinate RBAC + alert tuning with platform-bot.
Ivy: Thanks. Action items summarized: Sofia -> prototype + perf (72h), Ivy -> playbook + cache-key spec (48h), Ben -> RBAC + alert tuning (24h). Revisit in sync after artifacts. :thumbsup:
